scope: One full local Release run; Debug and ASan/UBSan affected groups only. Historical 1533 full matrices and hosted runs predate the MCP/CLI fixes. No browser production behavior change, no new TSan or fuzz run. Prior OOP hover cause remains OPEN.
source_state: Working tree changes based on the named base commit, identified by source hashes below; no hosted result is claimed for these changes.

findings.before: An invalid CDP_PORT blocked valid CHROMERELAY_PORT, and invalid environment values blocked explicit --port. Informational commands also failed before doing their work.
findings.after: Resolve CLI > CHROMERELAY_PORT > CDP_PORT > 9222, then validate only that selected value; help/version/catalog commands do not need a port.
findings.regressions: CLI 17 to 28 checks, including actual configured port readback without a browser.

findings.before: Malformed clientInfo or initialized notification parameters could advance lifecycle state; null arguments reached a tool as an empty object; unknown tools and malformed arguments were reported as execution errors.
findings.after: Require clientInfo name/version strings, silently ignore malformed initialized notifications, reject non-object explicit tool arguments and unknown names with -32602, and retain execution errors for known-tool argument values.
findings.regressions: MCP contract 23 to 43 checks; real stdio MCP 52 to 55 checks; compatibility names and both protocol versions retained.

references.interpretation: Unknown tool names and malformed tools/call request shapes receive JSON-RPC errors. Errors in values supplied to an existing tool retain isError:true tool results.
Client name/version are required strings. Tool arguments and notification params, when supplied, are objects. Omitting arguments remains allowed; explicit null is not an object.

audit_boundaries.target_session: Reviewed original-page bindings, remote-object session calls and evaluation retry boundaries. No new reproduced target/session defect in this review; existing target-affinity and cookie-context programs passed in the full Release run.
audit_boundaries.file_paths: Reviewed root pinning, canonical paths, upload revalidation and atomic screenshot output against FILES_AND_CAPTURE.md. Existing 40 file contracts, 59 live file checks, 24 PNG checks and 23 MCP file checks passed. The documented final Chrome file-open race and arbitrary page-script access remain explicit limits.
audit_boundaries.installation: Fresh Release install, 28 installed CLI checks, and independent CMake consumer catalog build/run. No desktop MCP-host UI or personal-profile validation is claimed.

publication_note: Selected text transcripts are copied with local source and evidence prefixes replaced by placeholders. Complete raw records remain local; historical sources and evidence were not changed.
